panels.description: Outside GODARAZ, the contractor loads the temporary service equipment into his vehicle. The crude tractor jumper remains attached but inadequate. Guddu stands at the threshold. Keep upper-left clear.
Guddu finds the empty service point while Pinty examines disconnected cables. The tractor cable is visibly insufficient. Keep the top third open.
The apologetic goons drive away with the removed service equipment loaded in the vehicle toward Saand’s site. Keep the oversized z and warehouse wall in frame.
Inside GODARAZ, festoon lights go dark one row at a time. Guddu stands beneath them with his permit folder. Keep upper-left darkness clear.

items.speaker: CONTRACTOR
items.text: I said many things before breakfast.

items.speaker: PINTY
items.text: Tractor power is a test. Not a business.
